title: Same email can register twice with different capitalisation
issue: Two accounts were created for the same person: one signed up as Alice@Example.com and later someone registered as ' alice@example.COM'. Email addresses must be unique regardless of letter case and surrounding spaces; the second signup should be rejected with EmailTaken.

title: Declined payments still reserve seats
issue: When a customer's card is declined, the seats they tried to buy stay reserved and the show starts looking sold out even though nobody paid. A declined payment must not hold any seats and must not create a booking.

title: Upcoming events list misses and misorders events
issue: The upcoming events page is wrong: a show on 5 January 2027 is missing even though it is in the future, and events are not listed soonest-first when they span different months and years.
